params.P020: fire = phase_dec == NY; reported as a base-rate census (concentration ratio = winner share / candidate share, per asset x era x phase, broken out by side and by D-071 class)
params.P021: fire = day_type == EXPANDED AND surprise >= 0.99, both read from the DECISION PHASE's fvol row exactly as sections.s2_regime and sections.s9_vol read them
params.P021_interaction: BREAKOUT vs REVERSION direction x the EXPANSION flag, difference-in-differences, session-clustered CR1. Reading A: side == range-extension side (the more recent phase extreme). Reading B: ext_needed > $450 (P017's own threshold)
params.P022: fire = sign(phase sflow) disagrees with BOTH sign(30m sflow) and sign(5m sflow) (all three non-zero) AND 0 <= last_scheduled release age < 5400s
params.P022_direction: among flagged candidates: side aligned with the LIVE short windows vs with the PHASE fossil vs with the D10 EVENT-ANCHORED window (flow since the release)
params.destruction: each term shuffled WITHIN SESSION, 40 replicates, RandomState(20260815 + term index); the other terms untouched. The destroyed quantity is the EDGE (mean cert of the firing set minus mean cert of the non-firing rest)

frame.causality: every window is searchsorted on the SANE second grid and bounded at dec_sec; ZigZag pivots kept only when conf_sec < dec_sec
frame.event_window: D10 — sflow over [release_sec, dec_sec) when a SCHEDULED release (BLS + FOMC calendars, context._bls_calendar / context._fomc_calendar) landed inside the running phase. The release is availability-lagged the same way S12's `last_scheduled` is: only events with event_ts STRICTLY < decision_ts are visible (CC-M2-1.2), and the calendar itself is SCHEDULE_EXEMPT under D-057 because the dates are published months ahead. The window NEVER spans the release second: it starts AT it.

fields.cert_close_usd: c_c_roster.certificates(...)[1][0] — the walled PHASE-CLOSE certificate (the CC-M1-8 adoption metric)
fields.cert_peak_usd: c_c_roster.certificates(...)[0][0] — the walled PEAK-EXIT companion (CC-M1-8 mandatory column)
fields.coverage_phase: sections.s3_path COVERAGE for the running phase = SANE range so far in the phase / (move_q50_usd_per_sigma * sigma_hat_usd) of that phase's fvol row; NaN when the fvol row carries no q50 (REFUSED, V1.1 D1)
fields.coverage_session: the same number on the SESSION clock/forecast
fields.day_type: S2 day_type_so_far as an ordinal: 0 INSIDE (<0.60), 1 AT_RANGE (<1.00), 2 EXPANDED (>=1.00); -1 = REFUSED
fields.day_type_frac: S2 range_so_far / range_hat — the '% of range_hat' the sheet prints; NaN when range_hat is REFUSED
fields.event_in_phase: the release landed INSIDE the running phase and before the decision: phase_seg_start <= release_sec < dec_sec
fields.ext_needed_usd: NEW range beyond the phase extreme the $1,000 bar still needs: max(0, 1000 - (entry_mid - phase_lo)*mult) for a SHORT, max(0, 1000 - (phase_hi - entry_mid)*mult) for a LONG (e1d1_policy T3 / P016 clause 1)
fields.extreme_age_sec: dec_sec - phase_hi_sec (SHORT) or - phase_lo_sec (LONG): the age of the phase extreme the trade fades
fields.f30m_n: S8 30m window trade count, sec in [dec-1800, dec)
fields.f5m_n: S8 5m window trade count, sec in [dec-300, dec)
fields.f60_n: S8 60s window trade COUNT, sec in [dec-60, dec)
fields.fev_n: EVENT-ANCHORED window (D10) trade count over [release_sec, dec); -1 = REFUSED (no release inside the phase)
fields.fev_sflow: event-anchored signed flow (buy_vol - sell_vol) — the flow accumulated SINCE the release, never across it; 0 with fev_n = -1 = REFUSED
fields.fph_n: S8 phase window trade count, sec in [phase_seg_start, dec)
fields.fph_sflow: S8 phase cumulative signed flow (buy_vol - sell_vol)
fields.ladder_band: sections.s9_vol ladder_position as an ordinal (see LADDER_BANDS); -1 = REFUSED (no move_q* in the fvol row)
fields.level_dist_atr: |nearest KEPT-family level price - entry_mid| / ATR, over levels alive at dec_sec (V1.1 birth guard) and within +/-1.5xATR; NaN when there is none
fields.mid_now: SANE mid at dec_sec (last SANE second <= dec_sec)
fields.phase_hi_sec: FIRST second at which phase_hi was reached
fields.phase_lo_sec: FIRST second at which phase_lo was reached
fields.phase_seg_end: one past the last second of that segment
fields.phase_seg_start: first second of the phase SEGMENT containing dec_sec
fields.pivot_age_sec: dec_sec - pivot_sec of the most recent CAUSAL ZigZag pivot of the faded type (HIGH for a SHORT, LOW for a LONG), conf_sec < dec_sec; -1 = none yet
fields.range_hat_usd: S2/S9 `range_hat_usd` of the DECISION PHASE's fvol row (both sections read case.fvol_seg); NaN = REFUSED
fields.range_so_far_usd: S2 range_so_far = SANE session range over [0, dec) in dollars (= range_sess_usd)
fields.release_age_sec: decision_ts - release_ts, the S12 `last_scheduled` age; -1 = no prior scheduled release
fields.release_sec: release_ts on the SESSION clock (release_ts - open_utc); -1 = none
fields.release_ts: epoch second of the most recent SCHEDULED release strictly BEFORE decision_ts (BLS + FOMC calendars, SCHEDULE_EXEMPT per D-057 — the dates are known months ahead); -1 = none
fields.session_close_exit: phase_close_sec == sess_close_sec — the S13 exit_default IS the session close
fields.slope_1m_usd: sections.s5_tminus mid_slope last-minute column = (mid(dec) - mid(dec-60)) * mult
fields.spread_ratio: spread_dec_usd / phase-median spread (c_a_cost, per asset x year x phase) — the P005 'spread tax' state
fields.surprise: S9 realized_range_so_far / range_hat, where the realized range is the PHASE segment's [seg_start, dec) SANE range (S9's own numerator, not S2's); NaN = REFUSED
fields.walled: the $-wall was hit on the adverse skeleton
fields.winner: cert_close >= $1000 and mae <= $300 and not walled (D-021)

params.grading: CC-M2-9.1 — ENTRY RULE / VETO RULE (Holm-significant beta on the adoption metric) vs WINNER CONCENTRATOR (>= 1.25x winner rate or conditional value with no adoption edge -> feature candidate set only) vs NULL
params.inference: CC-M1-12.4 — GEE independence working correlation with the Liang-Zeger sandwich clustered on SESSION (CR0 + Cameron-Miller CR1); Kish one-way ICC/DEFF for n_eff; Holm-Bonferroni over THE WHOLE BATCH (every GEE test of all three patterns and both interaction readings is one family)
params.population: frozen v3 roster, FIT years [2021, 2022, 2023, 2024]; 2025 = GATE echo, EVAL-ONLY
params.value: c_c_roster.certificates — walled PHASE-CLOSE (adoption) and walled PEAK-EXIT (CC-M1-8 companion), both always reported
params.winner: cert_close >= $1000 and mae_before_argmax <= $300 and not walled (D-021)
